title: Inside tanks.
officialText:
The gauging of inside tanks by means of measuring sticks shall not be permitted. An inside tank provided with fill
and vent pipes shall be provided with a device to indicate either visually or audibly at the fill point when the oil in the tank has reached a
predetermined safe level.
